== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Sealing and [[Binding magic|binding magic]] is a specialized magical discipline focused on containment, restriction, and protection. While some practitioners view them as distinct arts, they can be unified under a single philosophy of keeping elements out or holding things in place. This magic is often manifested through [[Aetheric sigils]], spinning [[magic circle|magic circles]], or glowing symbols in colors such as white, blue, or green. [[Binding magic]] is primarily used to secure targets, lock enemies in position, or knit physical wounds together. It can take the form of a constricting serpent to imprison individuals or be used to stitch complex structures back together. Sealing magic serves a broader range of defensive and restrictive purposes, such as shielding against dangerous elements, locking away powerful curses, or protecting ships within [[Subspace]]. High-level applications include the ability to isolate targets within a pocket of [[Subspace]] or even lock away massive geographical features like mountains. The discipline also encompasses several sub-specialties and advanced techniques, including [[contract magic]] and [[enchantment]]. Practitioners can use these spells to create spell-anchors—concentrated spheres of overlapping [[magic circle|magic circles]] used for permanent containment—or to establish magical contracts that bind individuals to specific services or organizations. Although effective for control and defense, these spells are generally noted to be slower and easier to resist with [[aura]] than [[elementalism]].}}
